title: Injectivity in the local proper-flat structure-sheaf criterion
statement: Let f:X→S be proper, flat and locally of finite presentation, and let s∈S. If the canonical map on the fibre over s is an isomorphism, then the stalk map induced by the tensor pullback/direct-image adjunction unit is injective.

source.place: Tag 0E62, proof of perfect-lemma-proper-flat-h0, localized at s

proof.text: The assumed isomorphism on fibre global sections is injective. If the fibre were empty, its top open would be bottom and its global sections would be a subsingleton ring. The images of zero and one would coincide, contradicting zero_ne_one in the global sections of Spec of the residue field. Thus choose a fibre point, and use Scheme.Hom.fiberHomeo to get x in X with f x = s.

The stalk homomorphism O_{S,s} to O_{X,x} is flat by Flat.stalkMap and local by f.toLRSHom.prop. Apply Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom and RingHom.FaithfullyFlat.injective, exactly as in Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.epi_of_flat_of_surjective.

Represent two input module germs by sections. If their ordinary structure-map images agree, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq gives a base neighbourhood W where the direct-image sections agree. Naturality rewrites this as equality of f.app W on the restricted input sections. Taking germs at x, Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply and injectivity from the preceding step give equality of their base ring germs. Apply germ_eq once more to those ring germs and then germ_res_apply to get equality of the input abelian module germs. All comparisons here are the explicit section formulas of the unit module and unitToPushforwardObjUnit.

Use tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso to identify the chosen tensor adjunction unit composed with pushforward of tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit with the ordinary structure map. Map this identity through the abelian stalk functor. Applying the stalk of the pushforward comparison to any equality under the chosen unit gives equality under the ordinary structure map. Cancel it by step 3.

proof_origin.description: Shorter underived injectivity proof: nonempty fibre, injectivity of a flat local ring map, germ calculations and the proved tensor structure-sheaf comparison. The flat local-ring argument is that of Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.epi_of_flat_of_surjective; the comparison is Stacks Tags 0096 and 01CA.
